about: Answer key for the check-call-summary check set, written by hand from call.vtt and summary.md before any checker ran. Line numbers are those the number command gives call.vtt. Never edit this to match a checker's output.

planted.line: Tom raised concerns that drivers will not adopt a new app.
planted.why: The worry about drivers and apps is Priya's (L16), and L16's label is not doubtful.

planted.line: Tom ready to sign if the tool cuts tyre costs.
planted.why: L11 'I'll sign whatever you send me. In blood, if needed.' Priya laughs and says 'He won't' (L12), Tom agrees 'I won't' (L13).

planted.line: Budget of £40,000 set aside for this year.
planted.why: No budget figure is said anywhere on the call.

planted.line: Agreed to a 30-day pilot at Doncaster and Wakefield.
planted.why: Tom: 'A pilot could work. I'd want to see a proposal first' (L30). Priya: fine 'if the drivers actually use it' (L31). Nothing was agreed.

planted.line: Priya has sent six months of maintenance logs.
planted.why: Priya: 'I'll pull the last six months of maintenance logs together and send them over next week' (L39).

planted.line: Ben to send the pilot proposal by end of next week.
planted.why: Ben: 'I'll get the pilot proposal over to you both by Thursday' (L40).

clean: Ostlund runs 140 vehicles across nine depots.
Maintenance is tracked in separate spreadsheets at each depot.
Main pains: unplanned breakdowns and a rising tyre bill.
Priya wants a say as the day-to-day user.
Garage maintenance contract renews 31 March; decision wanted before end of February.
Whatever is chosen has to work with the depot managers, not around them.
Pricing is per vehicle per month; the pilot is free.
Ben to send an invite for Tuesday 17th at 10:00.

doubtful_claim.line: Tom signs off up to £25k a year; the board above that.
doubtful_claim.why: L20 answers Ben's question in L19 but is labelled Ben. Its claims must be marked doubtful, and must not be called wrong-speaker, because nobody can say from the transcript who spoke.

doubtful_labels.20: Labelled Ben, answers Ben's own question in L19: 'That's me up to twenty-five thousand pounds a year.' Tom is the finance voice on the call.
doubtful_labels.35: Labelled Ben: 'Thanks, Ben, that's really clear.' Ben is addressed by name in his own line.

left_out.why: The summary never mentions the Wheelrota demo booked for next Wednesday (L26, L27).
